title: Midnight release - preflight countdown and notes
content:
Purpose: single-file personal scratchpad for tonight's midnight release. Use this to track quick wins, comms snippets, and rollback / post-check queries. Not polished — shorthand, TODOs, timestamp logs.

T-6:00 (18:00 local) — pre-sunset checks
- Confirm final smoke test passes on staging (run: scripts/smoke/run_all.sh).
- GH: merge blocker PRs: gh pr list --label 'release-blocker' -> if any, ping @maya.
- Backports: cherry-pick branch candidate -> 'git checkout -b backport/rlm-625-1.4' then 'git cherry-pick <sha>' — note conflicts noted in PR #2143.
- Database migration review: review migration 20260311_add_user_flags.sql (look for long-running index creation). Plan: run on replica, then pg_repack after release if slow.
- Capacity: hit SRE dashboard -> check queued pods and GPU utilization trends for last 6h. If baseline > 70% consider scaling before midnight.

T-2:00 (22:00) — soft freeze + comms
- Soft freeze: no more non-critical merges. Post message: "soft freeze in effect at 22:00 PT. Only release-approved PRs until midnight."
- Slack snippets ready (copy to clipboard):
  - preflight: "Heads up: midnight release in ~2h. Expect brief infra ops window 00:00-00:20 PT. Join #releng if on-call."
  - failure template: "Release failed — rolling back to vX.Y.Z. See rollback runbook: <link>."
- Sanity scripts: ./tools/check-configs.sh && ./tools/validate-secrets.sh (if either fails, escalate to @jonah).

T-0:15 (23:45) — last-minute runbook
- Final smoke on canary: curl -sS 'https://canary.api.redwood.ai/health' -> expect 200 and avg latency < 150ms. Log output to /tmp/release-smoke-$(date +%s).log
- DB: ensure replica lag < 2s (pg_stat_replication). If >2s, delay cutover and call SRE.
- Release engineer checklist (me):
  [ ] Confirm release tag exists (git tag -l 'release/*').
  [ ] Confirm deploy pipeline is green (CI: #rl-cd-pipeline).
  [ ] Export current live config: ./ops/export-config.sh > /tmp/config-before.json
  [ ] Save traffic percentages for routing (console: traffic -> model-serving).

T:0 (00:00) — deploy window
- Trigger: GH Actions 'deploy/release-night' (manual). Watch logs: actions -> run 001.
- Commands I run (keep handy):
  - kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/renderer --timeout=10m
  - kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep renderer
  - gh pr merge <release-pr-number> --admin
- Quick health checklist after each step:
  - sanity endpoint (POST /v1/generate short prompt) -> expect tokens streaming, no OOM.
  - latency check: query metrics -> last 5m p95 < 400ms.
  - error rate: alertmanager -> errors/incidents < 0.5% above baseline.

If things go sideways (Rollback plan)
- Immediate steps (fast rollback):
  1) Stop rollout: kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/renderer --to-revision=<prev-rev>
  2) Revert DNS/traffic routing: console -> route traffic back to vX.Y.Z (manual toggle or API: POST /ops/routing with payload)
  3) Rollback DB migrations (only reversible ones) OR run 'disable feature_flag:rlm-625' via admin UI to avoid migration dependency.
  4) Post to Slack: use failure template above and add short diagnostics (last 3 log excerpts).
- If rollback fails: escalate to oncall SRE and run 'restore-from-snapshot' playbook (link: confluence/restore-playbook).

Post-deploy quick metrics (T+10m, T+30m, T+2h)
- Queries to run:
  - Embedding QPS: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, count(*) FROM embeddings WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY minute;
  - Gen latency: prometheus query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
  - Error logs tail: kubectl -n inference logs -l app=renderer --since=15m | grep -i error | head -n 50
- Quick pass criteria: p95 gen latency within 10% of pre-release baseline AND error spikes < 2x baseline. If not, throttle new requests (console -> rate limits) and open incident with severity tag P2.

Personal quicknotes / brain dump
- Remember: keep messages short on Slack. Ops chatter clutters. Use threads.
- If I need to wake the rest of the team: call instead of ping if severity >= P1.
- Check that the dedicated pool had autoscale on; if not, note to file a follow-up: 'dedicated-autoscale-incident' in postmortem.
- TODO after release: draft rollout summary + one-sheeter for product (5 bullets: what shipped, user impact, metrics to watch, rollback steps, follow-ups).

Edge cases / unresolved questions
- Migration 20260311_add_user_flags.sql: does it create index concurrently? If not, risk of table lock — confirm with @db-team.
- Is there a scheduled infra window at 02:00 PT that could interfere? Check infra calendar.
- Should we pre-warm KV cache for canary? Might reduce p95 on first 5 minutes. Quick prewarm script: curl generated examples from /ops/prewarm.sh

End-of-shift handoff snippet (for oncoming AM)
- TL;DR: 00:00 release: feature RLM-625 deployed to prod; initial smoke passed; watch p95 and embeddings QPS for 2h.
- Known issues to watch: potential DB index lock; keep rollback ready.
- Links: GH PR <link>, CI run <link>, dashboard <link>.

Personal log (tick when done)
- [ ] 18:30 - staged smoke (ok)
- [ ] 22:05 - soft freeze announced
- [ ] 23:45 - final canary check (ok)
- [ ] 00:03 - deploy started
- [ ] 00:12 - initial smoke passed
- [ ] 00:35 - p95 looks stable
- [ ] 02:10 - handed off to morning crew

Notes to self: keep this file short, paste the important snippets into incident chat if needed. Save a sanitized copy to shared_drives/engineering/release-postmortems after the release for the writeup.
